sameSourceTypeScriptComparison.timingScope: One direct CLI compilation observation per profile of the same complete emitted compiler TypeScript source. Each elapsedMs is the profile report's phases[].compile.elapsedMs. This comparison does not establish whole-pipeline speedup, repeat-run variance, or cross-version artifact equality.
fieldsUnavailableFromCompletedLog: full per-profile diagnostics and command receipts
sameSourceTypeScriptComparison.artifactInspection: The exact report and phase files are retained in the compiler workflow artifact. The completed log prints the source digest and direct CLI elapsed times; unprinted report fields were not inferred.

generationTimingScope.source: Logged generation receipt timingsMs objects retained without alteration.
generationTimingScope.emit: Includes erasure, original IR inventory/checking, and TypeScript printing.
generationTimingScope.tscAndWrite: Includes TypeScript compilation together with evidence writes, hashing, recipe/toolchain identity work; it is not a pure CLI timing.
generationTimingScope.total: Elapsed generation observation on this workflow runner; changes between runs are not attributed solely to TypeScript.

historicalBoundary: Q(A) produces C1 through an explicit legacy-inventory boundary. Those observations remain in the C1 generation receipt and are not portable checker acceptance. Current C1 executable checker conformance and checked C2/C3 original-IR emission are independently logged. Historical recovery and the cached A TypeScript replay use the pinned TypeScript 5.8.3 profile; current generation uses TypeScript 7.0.2.

independentProvider.scope: Later exact-stream provider acceptance does not retroactively gate emission or alter the compiler receipts.
